input.lugar: edge of a Uros floating island on Lake Titicaca near Puno, Peru
input.escena: dry golden totora reeds underfoot at the island edge and the open deep-blue lake toward the horizon; at one side the corner of a totora reed house and a neighbouring islet in the distance; a woman traveler in a jacket and knit hat stands looking at the water, at medium distance. It must read as high Andean plateau: high clean sky, strong light, dry air
input.clima: clear sky, high sun and cold wind, abundant light with open shadows, sky and water highlights retained
input.refLugar: the Uros floating islands: totora reed floor, reed houses and reed boats on the lake
input.prohibir: traditional dress used as costume, people posing for the camera, handicrafts for sale in the foreground, invented snowy mountains on the lake horizon
input.extra: COMPOSITION, MEASURED: the horizon line of the lake sits at about 45% of the frame height; the reed house corner, the neighbouring islet and the woman (small, head to feet between 22% and 48% of the height, centred between 40% and 60% of the width) all sit in the upper half. The lower half is the calm golden totora floor and the out-of-focus reeds, mid-tone, no faces or hands. SKY BRANDLIFT CONSISTENCY (Daniela Ferreira, SKY Blog visual system, sheet 15): believable traveler POV at eye height; luminous natural light with open shadows and whites that keep detail; natural colour where ochres, blues and skin keep their true tones, moderate contrast, no filter, no orange-teal grade, no HDR; real optical depth: the near element very out of focus with soft optical bokeh, the subject sharp; a spontaneous everyday moment, no pose. LENS: 28–35 mm equivalent, contextual and immersive.
